latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the pdf2markdown skill.
- Supports converting PDF and image documents (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP) to clean Markdown via the PDF2Markdown CLI.
- Handles both synchronous parsing (for files under ~30MB) and async parsing (for large files up to 100MB).
- Provides usage examples for direct file input and URL-based processing.
- Output is organized in a dedicated `.pdf2markdown/` directory; supports both Markdown and JSON formats.
- Requires pre-installation and authentication before use.
